function: Over-the-air aggregation for federated meta-learning (Air-meta-pFL); excluded as system: single-antenna devices and server (scalar channel h_i, M channel uses), no RIS (p. 8).
notes: Reason system, p. 8. The work passes checks 1 to 5 as area 7: it aggregates meta-pFL updates over the air (p. 8: "we adopt an analog communication strategy based on sparsification, linear compression, channel phase compensation, and power scaling"). The link is single-antenna with no RIS: p. 8: "complex channel h_i = |h_i|e^{j phi_i} between each device i ∈ [n] and the server", and the server "receives an M × 1 vector" over "a block of M channel uses"; p. 20: "block-flat Rayleigh fading channel, i.e., h_i ∼ CN(0, 1)". No antenna array, MIMO, beamforming, or RIS appears anywhere in the paper. The PDF is arXiv:2406.11569v6 (1 Dec 2025) by Wen, Xing, and Simeone. It does not print the DOI or the venue, and nothing in it points to a different paper.
